title: pp.grainrev~
description: `pp.grainrev~` is a stereo granular delay/reverb that processes a signal using triggered grains, with controls for grain size, delay, pitch, envelope, panning, feedback, and randomization. Grains can be triggered manually or by an internal metro; its obligatory first creation argument sets the maximum delay time, while the optional second sets the maximum number of grains (default 4).
